what: Moving the cursor over the map or chart board lights up the single nearest dot within 110px. The dot grows to 1.3x while a spreading glow (2.6x) and a ring (3.2x) expand over .6s, the card with the same name rises from 12px below over .6s, the zone of the same group darkens, and the lines touching that dot brighten. The other dots fade to .6. Every line changes thickness and brightness slightly by the distance from the cursor to the line’s midpoint (within 16% of the board width). Curve is cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)

options.glow: Distance at which the line reacts (px), default panel width × .1625
options.[data-fx-part=point]: Dot (button recommended) — name by data-key, grouped by data-group. Inside, [data-fx-part=If a dot] is placed, distance is measured to its center
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card with the same data-key as the dot (optional) — placement is up to the user
options.[data-fx-part=line]: svg path (optional) — two point names in data-a·data-b
options.[data-fx-part=group]: Group zone (optional) — is-active when data-key matches the dot’s data-group

use: …
note: Touch screens have no cursor, so tap a dot to turn on and tap an empty spot on the board to turn off

from.where: index.html .atlas__map — original EmotionalAtlas (15 places, radius 110px, line --near 260/1600)
